name: Apprenticeship — Draft POST With Prior Apprenticeship (Different Provider, Withdrawn)
description: Variant of 'Apprenticeship — Draft POST With Prior Apprenticeship (Previous AY)'. First creates a different apprenticeship (standard 30) for the same learner but with a DIFFERENT provider (10005078), due to end 2026-03-31 — AY 25/26, the previous academic year — then withdraws the learner from it (rather than completing) on 2026-03-31. The learner therefore already has one ApprenticeshipLearning row, belonging to a different provider, before the new draft POST (standard 21, provider 10005077) is sent. Tests whether the FLP-1537 known bug (CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle calls ApprenticeshipLearningRepository.GetByLearnerKey unconditionally on every POST, and GetByLearnerKey is .SingleOrDefaultAsync(x => x.LearnerKey == key) — throws InvalidOperationException the moment a learner has more than one ApprenticeshipLearning row) still reproduces when the prior row is scoped to a different provider. No approval step for the new course — use the Commitments Fake UI to approve.

steps.name: Commitments Approves a Prior Apprenticeship, Standard 30, Different Provider, Ending 2026-03-31 (AY 25/26)
SLD Records Withdrawal on the Prior Apprenticeship
SLD Create a New Draft Apprenticeship, Standard 21, Same Learner, Different Provider
